name: _bootstrap.py
mathematical_scope: Bootstrap selects a nested historical dependency tree and inserts it first on sys.path.
input_and_guard_coverage: A single adjacent_tail.py existence check accepts a cached directory; otherwise extracts an unverified ZIP or falls back to a fixed /mnt/data development path. No exact hashes, cache freshness, complete dependency list or archive limits.
costs: Extraction cost proportional to archive expanded bytes; no bound. Import path mutation applies globally.
test_evidence: No tests establish selected module origins or cached-tree contents.
acceptance_boundary: A basename/existence check is not dependency identity. Preserved inventory candidates are known, actual future imported bytes remain unbound.
findings: L6–13 permits stale cache or an unrelated local fallback to satisfy dependency selection. L14 allows historical tree modules to shadow current modules by name.
